title: Santa's Archives: Past Delays, Future Plans
description: Managed by santa-esql-advent: past-and-plan-v1. Compare external Christmas 2025 archives with the indexed 2026 delivery plan.

config.content:
## The Ghost of Christmas Past
Santa is preparing the 2026 delivery run. Compare the **2026 plan in Elasticsearch** with **2025 deliveries read directly from Parquet in MinIO**, then join both sources to inspect toy-train exposure.

A delivery is late when `delay_minutes > 0`.

data_source.query:
FROM santa_delivery_plan_2026
| STATS planned_deliveries = SUM(planned_deliveries) BY gift_category
| SORT planned_deliveries DESC, gift_category ASC
| LIMIT 10

FROM santa_deliveries_2025
| STATS total = COUNT(*), late = COUNT(*) WHERE delay_minutes > 0 BY gift_category
| EVAL late_rate = 100.0 * late / total
| SORT late_rate DESC, gift_category ASC
| LIMIT 10

FROM santa_deliveries_2025
| WHERE gift_category == "toy_train"
| STATS historical_total = COUNT(*), historical_late = COUNT(*) WHERE delay_minutes > 0 BY gift_category, carrier, country
| LOOKUP JOIN santa_delivery_plan_2026 ON gift_category, carrier, country
| EVAL historical_late_rate = 100.0 * historical_late / historical_total, illustrative_late_deliveries = 1.0 * planned_deliveries * historical_late / historical_total
| KEEP carrier, country, historical_total, historical_late, historical_late_rate, planned_deliveries, target_late_rate, illustrative_late_deliveries
| SORT historical_late_rate DESC, carrier ASC, country ASC
| LIMIT 10

config.content:
**Interpretation:** `illustrative_late_deliveries = planned_deliveries * historical_late / historical_total`. This applies the 2025 rate to the 2026 plan as an **illustrative unchanged-rate scenario, not a forecast**.

The 2025 archive remains external; only the 2026 plan is indexed. Data Federation is experimental, and this MinIO compatibility experiment is not officially supported by Elastic.
